component.name: MegaPDF
MegaPDF
component.summary: Remplir, cocher et signer des PDF
Remplir, cocher et signer des PDF

description.p: MegaPDF does the one job most people actually have with a PDF: someone sent you a form, and you need to send it back filled in, checked off, and signed. No account, no subscription, no cloud. Everything happens on your own computer.

ul.li: Check any box — real form fields and plain printed squares alike, including drawn checkboxes other apps treat as decoration.
Type on any line, in the size and face that matches the form. What you add is real, searchable text, not a sticker on top of the page.

Fix the document's own text. MegaPDF keeps the document's font where it can and says so when it had to use a similar one; if a change would disturb the rest of the page it tells you instead of quietly moving things.
Sign by drawing, or from a photograph of a signature on paper — the white background disappears. Signatures stay in a private library on your computer.
Save without fear. Every document is verified before your original is touched, so a failed save cannot corrupt the file someone sent you.
Search the whole document as you type, with every match counted.

description.p: MegaPDF makes no network connection and this package asks for no network permission. Your documents and your signature never leave your computer, because there is no server for them to go to. The app is open source, so anyone can check.
